input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have Wi-Fi where I am, so I rely on my mobile internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?

It looks like my phone is showing an airplane icon at the top, and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see anything about 4G or 5G, and I’m not sure about the signal bars. Does the airplane icon mean something important? What should I do next?

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see a signal icon with just one bar, it says "2G," and there’s something that looks like a crossed-out data symbol. The battery is still at 80%. My internet still isn’t working. What should I do now?

I changed the setting to prefer 4G and 5G, and now I see a signal icon with four bars and it says "5G" at the top. But there’s still a crossed-out data symbol, and my internet still isn’t working. Is there something else I should do?
I turned on mobile data, and now the crossed-out symbol is gone. I still see four bars and "5G" at the top. Should I try using the internet now, or is there something else I need to do first?
I tried using the internet, but it still isn’t working. I even tried a speed test, but it said there’s no connection. What should I do now? I really need this to work at the best speed possible.

I went ahead and reset the APN settings like you suggested. You mentioned I need to restart my phone for the changes to take effect. I’m a bit nervous—will restarting my phone make me lose any of my photos or anything important? I really don’t want to lose anything.

My phone restarted and everything looks the same—four bars, 5G, and data enabled—but I still can’t get online. I tried a speed test again, but it says there’s no connection. This is getting a bit frustrating. Is there anything else we can try? I really need excellent internet speed.

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have Wi-Fi where I am, so I rely on my mobile internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?

Thank you for reaching out about your mobile data issue. I can help you troubleshoot and improve your mobile data speed.

To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your mobile line,
- Your full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD),
- Or your customer ID (if you know it)?

Once I have this information, I can check your account and guide you through the steps to improve your mobile data speed.
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?

{"plan_id": "P1002", "name": "Premium Plan", "data_limit_gb": 15.0, "price_per_month": 65.0, "data_refueling_price_per_gb": 2.0}

Thank you, John. I’ve found your account and confirmed your line is active with a Premium Plan that includes 15GB of data per month. You’ve used about 8.7GB so far, so you still have data available.

To help improve your mobile data speed, I’ll guide you through a few steps. First, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- What signal strength you see (bars or signal icon)?
- If you see “4G,” “5G,” or another network type?
- If there are any icons like airplane mode or data saver showing?

This will help me understand your current connection and suggest the best next steps.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%

It looks like my phone is showing an airplane icon at the top, and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see anything about 4G or 5G, and I’m not sure about the signal bars. Does the airplane icon mean something important? What should I do next?

Yes, the airplane icon means that Airplane Mode is turned on. When Airplane Mode is enabled, all wireless connections—including mobile data—are turned off, which explains why your mobile data isn’t working.

To fix this, please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. You can usually do this by:
1. Swiping down from the top of your screen to open the quick settings menu.
2. Tapping the airplane icon so it is no longer highlighted.

Once you’ve turned off Airplane Mode, check if your mobile data starts working and if you see signal bars or a 4G/5G icon. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and if your data connection improves.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see a signal icon with just one bar, it says "2G," and there’s something that looks like a crossed-out data symbol. The battery is still at 80%. My internet still isn’t working. What should I do now?

Thank you for the update. Since your phone is showing only one bar of signal and is connected to "2G," your data speed will be extremely slow or may not work at all. For good internet, you need to be on at least "4G" or "5G."

Let’s try to improve your connection by changing your network mode preference to allow your phone to connect to faster networks. Please follow these steps on your phone:
1. Go to your phone’s Settings.
2. Find “Mobile Network” or “Cellular Network.”
3. Look for “Preferred network type” or “Network mode.”
4. Select the option that says “4G/5G preferred” or “LTE/5G.”

After you change this setting, check if your phone connects to 4G or 5G and if your data starts working. Let me know what you see after making this change. If you need step-by-step help with your specific phone model, let me know the brand and model, and I can guide you further.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%

I changed the setting to prefer 4G and 5G, and now I see a signal icon with four bars and it says "5G" at the top. But there’s still a crossed-out data symbol, and my internet still isn’t working. Is there something else I should do?

Thank you for updating the network mode. Now that you have a strong signal and are connected to 5G, but still see a crossed-out data symbol and no internet, there may be an issue with your mobile data settings.

Let’s try the following steps:
1. Make sure mobile data is turned ON in your phone’s settings.
2. If mobile data is already ON and it still doesn’t work, the issue could be with your Access Point Name (APN) settings.

Could you please check if mobile data is enabled? If it is, the next step will be to reset your APN settings to default, which often fixes data connection issues. Would you like instructions on how to reset your APN settings, or do you want to check your mobile data setting first?

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I turned on mobile data, and now the crossed-out symbol is gone. I still see four bars and "5G" at the top. Should I try using the internet now, or is there something else I need to do first?

Great job turning on mobile data! With four bars and "5G" showing, your connection should now be excellent.

Please try using the internet now—open a web page or an app that needs internet access—and let me know if it works and if the speed is good. If you still have issues or the speed is not as expected, let me know, and I can guide you through further steps to optimize your connection.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I tried using the internet, but it still isn’t working. I even tried a speed test, but it said there’s no connection. What should I do now? I really need this to work at the best speed possible.

Thank you for letting me know. Since you have a strong 5G signal and mobile data is enabled, but you still have no internet connection, the issue may be with your APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to the internet, even with a good signal.

The next step is to reset your APN settings to default. After resetting, you’ll need to restart your phone for the changes to take effect.

Would you like step-by-step instructions on how to reset your APN settings, or do you know how to do this on your device? If you tell me your phone’s brand and model, I can provide detailed instructions.

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

I went ahead and reset the APN settings like you suggested. You mentioned I need to restart my phone for the changes to take effect. I’m a bit nervous—will restarting my phone make me lose any of my photos or anything important? I really don’t want to lose anything.

Rest assured, restarting your phone will not delete any of your photos, messages, apps, or other important data. Restarting simply turns your phone off and back on, which helps apply the new APN settings and can fix many temporary issues.

You can safely restart your phone now. Once it turns back on, try using your mobile internet again and let me know if it works or if you still have any issues.

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed test failed: No Connection.

My phone restarted and everything looks the same—four bars, 5G, and data enabled—but I still can’t get online. I tried a speed test again, but it says there’s no connection. This is getting a bit frustrating. Is there anything else we can try? I really need excellent internet speed.

Thank you for your patience and for following all the steps so far. Since you have a strong 5G signal, mobile data is enabled, and your APN settings have been reset and applied, but you still have no internet connection, we’ve covered the main troubleshooting steps that can be done remotely.

At this point, there may be a deeper technical issue with your line or account that requires advanced support. I will transfer you to a human agent who can investigate further and resolve this for you.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
